name: Sequence-Function Interpretable Genomics Benchmark
description: A benchmark for assessing interpretable deep learning models that map genomic sequences to functional outputs.
reputation: A specialized benchmark used in genomics and interpretability research, with limited but meaningful adoption among researchers studying sequence-function models.
notes: Non-LLM bioinformatics benchmark; often evaluates both predictive performance and interpretability, and exact metrics can vary by subtask/dataset.
